name: Driehaus Museum
tagline: A Gilded Age mansion preserved as a museum. The most extravagant interior in Chicago.
description: Housed in the 1883 Samuel Mayo Nickerson House. The interior survived intact and was meticulously restored by the Driehaus Foundation, with collections of Tiffany glass, Herter Brothers furniture, and original woodwork. Among the best-preserved Gilded Age interiors in America.

tips.text: Book the curator's tour — the unguided self-walk misses half of what's worth seeing.

distance_landmark: River North, 3 blocks off Michigan Ave
